result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the promotional banner has a serious text-contrast problem and the horizontal restaurant carousel is clipped at the right edge without a visual scroll affordance.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' banner, the white heading and subtext ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') sit on a very light mint-green background, resulting in very low contrast that is hard to read and fails WCAG contrast guidelines.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker green background or darker text color so the heading and promo code text meet at least WCAG AA contrast ratios.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel cuts off the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right screen edge with no scroll indicator, gradient fade, or peeking affordance beyond the hard crop.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade or scroll hint and ensure consistent card spacing so users clearly understand the row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis styling that signals truncation clearly, which can look like a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis (…) and a max-width so long names degrade gracefully.
